unit:
[Service]
Type=exec
User=s2smoke
Group=s2smoke
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 HOME=/home/worker /usr/bin/python3 /opt/s2-smoke/worker.py
WorkingDirectory=/source
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
PrivateNetwork=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
Delegate=no
InaccessiblePaths=-/run/user -/run/dbus -/run/systemd/private -/run/containerd -/run/docker.sock -/root -/home/hyeon.guest/.ssh
ReadWritePaths=/source /scratch /home/worker /home/runner/cli-state
ReadOnlyPaths=/home/runner/cli-state/config.toml
CPUQuota=200%
MemoryMax=4G
TasksMax=256
RuntimeMaxSec=25
TimeoutStopSec=3
KillMode=control-group
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
config:
default_permissions = "fixture"
cli_auth_credentials_store = "file"
web_search = "disabled"

[features]
apps = false
hooks = false
multi_agent = false
daemon_auto_start = false
skill_mcp_dependency_install = false
system_proxy_fallback = false
use_legacy_landlock = false

[shell_environment_policy]
inherit = "none"
[shell_environment_policy.set]
PATH = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
HOME = "/home/worker"
TMPDIR = "/scratch"

[permissions.fixture.filesystem]
":root" = "deny"
":minimal" = "read"
"/source" = "write"
"/scratch" = "write"
"/home/worker" = "write"
"/materials" = "read"
"/home/runner/cli-state" = "deny"
"/opt/s2-smoke/public" = "read"
[permissions.fixture.network]
enabled = false
